'''Aleksandr Aleksandrovich Razborov''' ({{langx|ru|Алекса́ндр Алекса́ндрович Разбо́ров}}; born February 16, 1963), sometimes known as '''Sasha Razborov''', is a [[Soviet Union|Soviet]] and Russian [[mathematician]] and [[computational theorist]]. He is Andrew McLeish Distinguished Service Professor at the [[University of Chicago]].

== Research ==
In his best known work, joint with [[Steven Rudich]], he introduced the notion of ''[[natural proof]]s'', a class of strategies used to prove fundamental lower bounds in [[Computational complexity theory|computational complexity]]. In particular, Razborov and Rudich showed that, under the assumption that certain kinds of [[one-way function]]s exist, such proofs cannot give a resolution of the [[P versus NP problem|P = NP]] problem, so new techniques will be required in order to solve this question.

== Awards ==
[[File:Александр Разборов.jpg|thumb|Razborov in 2011]]
* [[Nevanlinna Prize]] (1990) for introducing the "approximation method" in proving [[Boolean circuit]] [[lower bound]]s of some essential [[algorithm]]ic problems,<ref name="razbNevanlinna">{{cite web|url=http://mathunion.org/General/Prizes/Nevanlinna/Prizewinners.html |title=International Mathematical Union: Rolf Nevanlinna Prize Winners |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071217145338/http://www.mathunion.org/General/Prizes/Nevanlinna/Prizewinners.html |archive-date=2007-12-17 }}</ref>
*  [[Erdős Lectures|Erdős Lecturer]], [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]], 1998.
*  [[Corresponding member]] of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] (2000)<ref name="razbRAS">{{cite web|url=http://ras.ru/win/db/show_per.asp?P=.id-5681.ln-en.dl-.pr-inf.uk-12|title=Russian Academy of Sciences: Razborov Aleksandr Aleksandrovich: General info: History|access-date=2008-01-21|archive-date=2018-04-01|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180401075841/http://ras.ru/win/db/show_per.asp?P=.id-5681.ln-en.dl-.pr-inf.uk-12|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name="razbRGAT">{{cite web|language=ru|url=http://rodstvo.ru/R/razin.htm#РАЗБОРОВ|title=Russian Genealogy Agencies Tree: R|access-date=2008-01-15|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071221003151/http://www.rodstvo.ru/R/razin.htm#РАЗБОРОВ|archive-date=2007-12-21|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* [[Gödel Prize]] (2007, with [[Steven Rudich]]) for the paper "[[natural proof|Natural Proof]]s."<ref name="razbGodelACM">{{cite web|url=http://sigact.acm.org/prizes/godel/2007.html|title=ACM-SIGACT Awards and Prizes: 2007 Gödel Prize}}</ref><ref name="razbGodelEATCS">{{cite web|url=http://eatcs.org/activities/awards/goedel2007.html|title=EATCS: Gödel Prize - 2007|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071201092326/http://www.eatcs.org/activities/awards/goedel2007.html|archive-date=2007-12-01}}</ref>
* [[David P. Robbins Prize]] for the paper "On the minimal density of triangles in graphs" (Combinatorics, Probability and Computing 17 (2008), no. 4, 603–618), and for introducing a new powerful method, flag algebras, to solve problems in extremal combinatorics
* [[Gödel Lecture]]r (2010) with the lecture titled ''Complexity of Propositional Proofs.''<ref>{{Cite web|title=Gödel Lecturers – Association for Symbolic Logic|url=https://aslonline.org/other-information/prizes-and-awards/godel-lecturers/|access-date=2021-11-10|language=en-US|archive-date=2021-11-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211108212958/https://aslonline.org/other-information/prizes-and-awards/godel-lecturers/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* [[Andrew MacLeish]] Distinguished Service Professor (2008) in the Department of Computer Science, [[University of Chicago]].
* Fellow of the [[American Academy of Arts and Sciences|American Academy of Arts and Sciences (AAAS)]] (2020).<ref>{{Cite journal|title=AAAS Fellows Elected|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/notices/202007/rnoti-p1051.pdf|journal=Notices of the American Mathematical Society}}</ref>
